candidates.change_summary: Replace call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with withdraw(address(this).balance - 1) so withdrawAll sends one wei less.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can call withdrawAll, changing who can cause the balance transfer.
Invert the onlyOwner check to require msg.sender != owner, so only non-owners can call functions protected by the modifier.
Make withdrawAll call withdraw with 0 so it performs no transfer even when called by owner.
Replace transfer to send (using return value) so withdraw does not revert on failed send and may leave funds in contract.
Relax onlyOwner check to allow any caller (remove require), changing who can call withdraw and thus observable withdrawn value.

Replace low-level call without handling return with a checked call that reverts on failure (adds require around the call result), which can change whether the call failure reverts the outer sendMoney and so affects subsequent state/visibility.
Change the low-level call to use send (which returns false on failure and forwards 2300 gas) instead of call, affecting whether the target receives funds and whether failures revert outer call.
Tighten the onlyOwner modifier to use assert instead of require, changing failure behavior (consume remaining gas / different gas semantics) on unauthorized calls to sendMoney.
Remove the ownership check from onlyOwner by making it a no-op, allowing non-owners to call sendMoney and thus changing observable state after sendMoney.
